title: deliver release review result
description: Result of the last release-review round of a milestone, written by deliver to <git-common-dir>/.agents/state/release-review-<key>.json; <key> is the unpadded M<n> or sub-number M<n>.<m> of the milestone title (M003 is M3: M3 and M003 share one state file; M4 also for M4 Topic and the closed M4 Topic (0.2.0); M1.1 for M1.1 Topic, never M1), legacy: the title.

milestone.description: The key: unpadded M<n> or M<n>.<m> (M003 is M3; never with a topic or the version in parentheses); legacy milestones: the title.
